note: Authored by agent per design_shortcuts_v1.md. Every shortcut is DIRECT: page expands steps client-side (resolve objects) and sends via existing ntfy transport. No LLM at tap time. Convention (2026-08-11): play shortcuts set volume to 18 before playing, unless the shortcut specifies otherwise. v17 (2026-10-03, p3.46): tiles with target:"selection" have no house/rooms — they play on the chips selected in the current house (resolve.selection → rooms = selectedRooms[house], room = rooms[0]; play_uri never regroups). inherit_volume:false skips the D10 default-volume injection (B1: leave levels as they are).

Same two-step shape as kcrw-e24-caphill-main: sync_rooms pins topology to exactly the two outdoor rooms (Lower Deck coordinator, 6s settle), then play_uri. play_uri carries BOTH rooms in `rooms` (service plays on rooms[0]'s live coordinator; the page's D10 tap-time inheritance then sets BOTH rooms to their live defaults — Lower Deck 39, Sauna Porch 35 — and D9 chips follow both). defaults.note: Default play volume per room. Used by play shortcuts without explicit volume, by play.ts (mode=play), by the agent when authoring new shortcuts, and (p3.21+) as JOIN-VOLUME: any room newly added to a group via Group Speakers / geo Extend / play.ts is reset to its default before the topology change lands. Rooms not listed use volume_fallback.
